paragraphs: Abaye. Rav Acha ben Abaye; Rav Bibi ben Abaye; Rabbi Yaakov ben Abaye; Rav Natan bar Abaye—requires examination; Rav Shimi ben Abaye—requires examination. [Glosses: Abaye: (a) Yevamot 101: Rabbi Acha bar Chanina said that Abaye said in Rabbi Assi’s name. It appears that Abaye is a scribal error and should read “Rabbi Ammi said,” for Rav Acha bar Chanina was Rav Huna’s student, and Abaye was Rabbah’s student, Rabbah being Rav Huna’s student; Rav Assi preceded Abaye. (b) Bava Batra, folio167b; Shabbat 57, end of b: “Abaye said in Rav’s name.” This requires examination, since Rav preceded him. (c) Zevachim 92b: “Rabbi Abaye asked”—a scribal error; the new Talmud editions have Rabbi Avin. (d) Kiddushin 19a: “Abaye, son of Rabbi Abbahu, said to him”—it should read Avimi; not corrected. (e) Zevachim 62b: Abaye bar Huna should read Avin; not corrected.]
